content.caseIdentity: Vineeta Sharma v. Rakesh Sharma, (2020) 9 SCC 1
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: The substituted s. 6 confers coparcenary status on daughters by birth; the father need not have been alive on 9 September 2005, subject to the statutory savings for earlier transactions.
content.holding: The substituted s. 6 confers coparcenary status on daughters by birth; the father need not have been alive on 9 September 2005, subject to the statutory savings for earlier transactions.
